body.p: This listing of claims replaces all prior versions of the claims.

1. (Currently Amended) A method, comprising:detecting determining, by a processing node that a transport has parked at a first location , a modified pickup time by a transport based on a conclusion of an event;
determine by the processing node a pickup location where the transport is to be located at a pickup time, wherein the pickup location and the pickup time are based on a time of a conclusion of the event obtained from a device of an occupant of the transport;and
in response to the processing node receiving a modified pickup time for the conclusion of the event from the device, causing by the processing node moving the transport to move to a second location [[an]] intermediate location between the first [[a]] location and the pickup location of the transport after it has been parked and a modified pickup location at the modified pickup time.
2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising:causing moving the transport to move to the modified pickup location when the [[a]] device associated with the transport approaches the modified pickup location.
3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the detecting that the transport has parked at the first location further comprises comprising:detecting that the parking of the transport has parked at the first location based on video data received from at least one camera.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, comprising:receiving an agreement to move the transport from the [[a]] device associated with the transport.
7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, comprising:determining the second intermediate location based on one or more vehicles vacating a parking spot between the first location of the parked transport and the modified pickup location.
